description.narrative: The Fund is expected to increase access to private equity (PE) capital and value creation for companies in Ukraine (around 80% of Fund size) and Moldova, including furthering investments in women-owned/led companies. PE funds play an important role in times of uncertainty, as they provide a flexible source of capital to companies and can rapidly pivot and assist companies in responding to changing conditions. The Fund Manager remains committed to Ukraine and has a dedicated operations advisory team to support portfolio companies to manage the current situation and develop strategies to enable growth and market expansion. The Fund also intends to invest in at least 25 percent women-owned/led companies, in a Region where only five percent of PE and venture capital (VC) funding goes to women-owned/led businesses. The investment will also support the resilience of the PE market in Ukraine, ensuring it remains functioning and providing capital to growth stage companies in a time of high instability.

The proposed project consists of (i) an additional IFC equity commitment of up to $30 million in Horizon Capital Growth Fund IV (HCGF IV or the Fund) in addition to an already existing commitment of up to $30 million in the Fund leading to a total commitment of up to $60 million, and (ii) a co investment envelope of up to $30 million, on a delegated authority basis, to invest in select companies alongside Emerging Europe Growth Fund III (EEGF III) and HCGF IV. HCGF IV is a private equity (PE) fund with a target size of $250 million. The Fund will invest primarily in mid-cap fast-growing technology and export-oriented companies, primarily active in Ukraine (around 80% of Fund size) and Moldova (the Region) benefiting from cost competitive local platforms with global reach.
